published.source: Second race re-pick 2026-10-27 (standards 29 and 16, after dev notes post 8): Undead; verify.py, 20000 iterations, seed 1 (was 949.2 as Human on the same sim)

summary: Deep Shadow with Discipline points for Twin Disciplines, Silent Resolve (threat), Mental Strength and Inner Focus, and 3 Holy points for Twilight Focus's pushback protection.
rotation: Pre-pull: Shadowform at -4.5s, Shadowguard (Troll) at -3s, Mind Blast at -1.5s that lands at the pull; the on-use trinket and Major Spellblasting Potion at -0.1s
Dark Sacrifice (Undead) below 10% mana; racials and trinkets on cooldown
Shadow Word: Pain whenever it is down (9+ s left in the fight)
Devouring Plague whenever it is down and off its 24s cooldown (12+ s left)
Shadow Word: Death on cooldown, then Inner Focus right before Mind Blast and Mind Blast on cooldown
Shadowguard (Troll) again once its charges are spent, with 60+ s left and 40%+ mana
Mind Flay to fill; clipped after the second tick if SW:P or Devouring Plague fell off, never clipped for Mind Blast
Wand Shoot from 10% to 20% mana with 60+ s left, and when nothing else can be cast (Shadow never gets that low)
caveats: Only the 2-piece set bonus is active. Raiments 4-piece and 5-piece are not measured with Devouring Plague's 24s cooldown.
Periodic spells crit per tick (Forever rule). Assumed: Shadow Weaving applies to the priest's own Shadow damage.
Mind Flay rolls hit once and isn't hasted. SW:Death backlash is ignored.
Left out: Brilliant Wizard Oil (+12.5) and Elixir of Sages (+13.9).
Improved Mind Flay compounds: each tick does 20% more than the last. Dark Inspiration's Spirit applies to the priest only.
Mana barely matters (about 13 min to empty).
notes: Request from mksettings unchanged (spec shadow, 180s, durationVariation 20); it matches the shipped encounter and DefaultConsumes. Regenerated 2026-10-23 from mksettings (natural flask zone on) and the ui APLs, which tools/rotopt/priest_presets.sh writes from the templates. Talents regenerated 2026-10-23 with Silent Resolve 3 pinned (standards 26): mksettings -talents 00530400102-3-50052101231302251, otherwise unchanged; the sapper alone stays (every filler explosive loses, standards 11).
